verdict.rationale: There is a working llms.txt at docs.aws.amazon.com/llms.txt covering AWS documentation broadly, and SES doc pages are available in a markdown-friendly format (.md suffix) that an agent could fetch directly. However, evidence doesn't show an SES-specific llms.txt or dedicated agent-oriented docs page, and there's no OpenAPI/agent-tool spec (openapi.json probes all 404). missing for 10: SES-specific llms.txt file, explicit agent-oriented documentation section, machine-readable API spec for agent consumption.
